name: Glengoyne
house_style: Slow-distilled, unpeated Highland single malt with a sherry-led signature: dried fruit, nutty oak and gentle spice, always bottled at natural colour and non-chill-filtered. The distillery prides itself on the slowest distillation in Scotland, capturing a clean, fruit-forward spirit; the recent White Oak / Oak Masters' series pivots the same spirit toward bright bourbon/virgin-oak vanilla-and-citrus territory.
notes: Sits on the Highland Line near Dumgoyne (stills in the Highlands, warehouses across the road in the Lowlands). Core range is sherry-led (12/15/18/21/25). The Oak Masters' Series (debut White Oak, 2024 UK / 2025 US) marks a deliberate 'new flavour direction' away from sherry toward American first-fill bourbon and virgin oak.
